title: Bhaiya abbas
body:
abbas abbas abbas mere bhaiya
bazaar mein zainab hai bhaiya bhaiya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
mere bhai bata doo kisko sada ab tere siwa abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
na sar pe tera saaya na sar pe rida ghazi
majma hai tamashayi aati hai haya ghazi
aa ghazi aa mere bhai aa deti hoon sada abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghazi mere baba ki jis shehr mein thi shaahi
us shehr mein qaidi hai us shehr ki shehzadi
tere baad mera kya haal hua aa dekh zara abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
mere bhai bata doo kisko...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai tere sahare par pardes chali aayi
kuch bhi na raha mera jab tu na raha bhai
bin tere safar aur be-chadar dil toot gaya abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad na bhoolega yun shaam shehr aana
bazar nibha aayi darbar hai ab jaana
waada ho wafa bhai se mera karna ye dua abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
mere bhai bata doo kisko...
abbas abbas abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna mere bhaiya se sharminda ye behna hai
saumpa tha jise mujhko zakhmi wo sakina hai
masooma ko mazlooma ko zindan mila abbas
bhaiya bhaiya abbas bhaiya bhaiya abbas
bazaar mein zainab hai...
abbas abbas abbas...
author: N. Sarwar, J. Jaffri & A. Shanawar
